draft: Mexico City now boasts a society transformed through widespread support for radical change. Corporations operate as worker-owned cooperatives, sharing profits with residents. Abundant green spaces are managed sustainably by hydrologists and permaculture experts in collaboration with communities. Social conflicts have diminished due to strong bonds of solidarity and trust. The authoritarian state has evolved into a participatory system with open-door ministries focusing on mutual aid and public welfare, while surveillance is minimal and replaced by a culture of cooperation. Capitalist hegemony has given way to an equitable economic model where resources flow freely among community members.
